title: Compose — Compare to Playbook — Output Schema (compose-compare-to-playbook)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='compose-compare-to-playbook' (spaarkeai-compose-r2 task 041, FR-08). MIRRORS VERBATIM the outputSchema in infra/dataverse/actions/compose-compare-to-playbook.action.json. Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required arrays, no anyOf/oneOf/discriminator; overallRisk is a constrained string via the enum keyword.
$comment-required: Object-level required arrays only — property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN.

matches.description: One entry per relevant playbook comparison. Empty when no relevant firm-standard was supplied.

playbookEntryId.description: Id of the supplied matter/firm playbook entry (id ONLY — never quoted content).

clauseText.description: The drafted clause text this comparison concerns.

deviations.description: Concrete differences from the firm-standard language (each a short phrase). Empty when compliant.

riskScore.description: Deviation risk in [0,1]: 0 = fully compliant, 1 = severe deviation.

overallRisk.description: Overall risk label for the selected clause versus the playbook.
